title: Influence of TMJ health on mandibular motion and the restorative position: A case series
html: Articulator settings were compared between adapted-unstable and healthy-stable states in 5 patients with subclinical temporomandibular disorders. Leaf gauge load testing was used to identify muscle-related dysfunction, while mechanical pantography and computerized axiography recorded mandibular motion in both states. Following stabilization with occlusal device therapy, coincident centric relation recordings on a verification device confirmed the transition to a healthy state and revealed a shift in the reproducible centric relation position.
